Accelerated: weekly is a quarter and biweekly half of the monthly payment, so you pay the equivalent of 13 monthly payments a year. Semimonthly is half, quarterly three times and annual twelve times the monthly payment.

Interest is charged each period at the annual rate divided by the number of payments a year.
